text.en: Meena stirred sugar into water and then sand into water. "One disappears, the other settles," she said.

Matter is classified into pure substances and mixtures. An atom is the smallest unit of an element that takes part in a chemical reaction. A molecule is the smallest unit of a pure substance that can exist independently. When two or more elements combine chemically, the new substance is a compound.
A mixture can be homogeneous, where the parts cannot be seen separately, or heterogeneous, where they can. Mixtures are separated by methods suited to the parts: sublimation, solvent extraction, simple and fractional distillation, centrifugation and chromatography.
A solution is a homogeneous mixture in which the component in the smaller amount is the solute and the one in the larger amount is the solvent. Solutions may be solid, liquid or gas. Suspensions and colloids are heterogeneous mixtures whose particles are bigger.

problem.en: In salt water which is the solute and which the solvent?

text.en: The solute is present in the smaller amount.
